desc:
Experience hilarious ragdoll physics, crazy falls, and unexpected crashes in Locust Ragdoll!

🎯 Push, throw, and launch Locust into crazy situations!
💥 Watch Locust tumble, bounce, and crash with realistic ragdoll physics
🗺️ Explore different areas and experiment with fun obstacles
⚡ Discover different ways to send Locust flying
😂 Create hilarious and unexpected ragdoll moments
🎮 Enjoy chaotic physics gameplay with endless possibilities!

🎮 Play on PC, Mobile, Tablet, and Console!

⭐ Like the game and favorite it to support future updates!
